name: PR outcomes
description:
Shows: Factory PRs closed in the last 30 days by outcome (merged_first_pass, merged_after_revise, closed_unmerged), autonomy label and agent. Reads pr.closed.
Why it matters: Breaks acceptance down into counts so the waste is visible: every closed_unmerged PR is a full build that delivered nothing. The autonomy split shows how much ships without a human in the loop.
